summary: Iteration 2: 3 new features (run summary, plan adapt, notification reminders) tested end-to-end. Backend 6/6 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend flows verified on mobile viewport: Calendrier adapt-week-button triggers Claude adaptation (~10s), coach note renders in adapt-note card, week reloads with new sessions; Progression run tile (run-run_4d2a1a46548b) navigates to /run/summary/[id] which correctly displays distance/time/pace, SVG polyline route trace, and per-km splits; Profil notif-switch on web gracefully shows 'Autorise les notifications pour activer les rappels.' without crashing. No blockers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/plan/upcoming is defined AFTER /api/sessions/{id} but they use different path prefixes (/plan/... vs /sessions/...), so no route-order collision — verified by test.
notifications.ts uses Notifications.SchedulableTriggerInputTypes.DATE which is supported by expo-notifications; graceful catch on Profile toggleNotif prevents web crash — OK.
run/summary/[id].tsx: RouteTrace SVG handles <2 point routes with fallback UI — good.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded run_4d2a1a46548b for thomas@pace.app. Test also creates a temporary run via POST /api/runs to validate splits persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth: thomas@pace.app / secret123 (plan already active, 4 weeks). Seeded run for summary UI: run_4d2a1a46548b. Adapt endpoint takes 8-25s. Notifications are unsupported on web — the app must only show a graceful message, not crash.
